Class Action

java.lang.Object
edu.uky.cs.nil.sg.Symbol
edu.uky.cs.nil.sg.Action
All Implemented Interfaces:
Commented, Consenting, Comparable<Action>
public class Action extends Symbol implements Comparable<Action>, Consenting
An action is a story graph symbol that represents an event in a story. Actions have a (possibly empty) set of consenting characters who are the agents responsible for taking the action. When an action occurs, it typically changes the state by changing which values are assigned to the state's fluents and by modifying the beliefs of some characters.

New actions should be created in a story graph using the ActionList.add(String) method.

Actions are the labels of temporal edges.

Author:
Stephen G. Ware

  • Field Details

    • consenting

      public final Set<Character> consenting
      The set of characters who are responsible for taking this action. Not all characters involved in the action are necessarily consenting characters. This set is immutable, but it can be modified by the ActionList.add(Action, Character) and ActionList.remove(Action, Character) methods.
